title: Video: All the Business News You Need Before Friday's Opening Bell
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Friday's opening bell :  

Apple ( AAPL ) disclosed two security risks to Mac and iOS devices. Sears ( SHLD ) said it would close more than 100 more stores in 2018. Former CEO Travis Kalanick will sell around 30% of his Uber shares. GoPro ( GPRO ) is reportedly laying off between 200 and 300 employees. Futures pointed higher ahead of Friday's jobs report.
